title: Innate Pharma announces conference call for third quarter 2026 business and financial update
body_markdown:
** Tue, 10/20/2026 - 07:00


Innate Pharma SA (Euronext Paris: IPH; Nasdaq: IPHA) (“ **Innate** ” or the “ **Company** ”) today announces that the Company will hold a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 2 p.m. CET / 8 a.m. ET, to provide a business and financial update for the third quarter of 2026.


Participants during the call will be:


- Jonathan Dickinson, Chief Executive Officer
- Markus Jensen, Vice President, Chief Medical Officer
- Yannis Morel, Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer
- Stéphanie Cornen, Vice President, Investor Relations and Communications
- Frédéric Lombard, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer


**Event details:**


**Date and time:** November 5, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. CET / 8:00 a.m. ET
**Webcast link:**[Click here](https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/754351455)
**Conference call link:**[Click here](https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/754351455?pwd=yoYvfGw3)


This information is also available on the Investors section of the Innate Pharma website,[www.innate-pharma.com](https://www.innate-pharma.com/) . A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company website for 90 days following the event.
